citations.field: PDF p. 38, printed p. 26; 班 entry; scan pixels directly inspected
citations.text: The 班 entry identifies the graph as 会意 and proposes that a knife divides jade, with the proposed original sense “divide auspicious jade.” Its form sequence is labeled Western Zhou (1), Spring and Autumn (2), Warring States (3), Shuowen small seal (4), Han (5), and regular script. The citation line matches those numbered forms: 1–2 cite 《金文编》 p. 26; 3 cites 《战文编》 p. 17; 4 cites 《说文》 p. 14; 5 cites 《篆隶表》 p. 26. I found no mismatch in the printed markers or bibliography, so the prior proposed OCR correction for this line is unsupported. The entry does not identify the two modern 王 shapes individually as 玨. The following supplied scan, PDF p. 39 (printed p. 27), has no continuation of the 班 entry. Edition: 2012 first edition, December; second printing July 2013; Tianjin Ancient Books Press and Liaoning People's Publishing House; ISBN 978-7-5528-0069-2.
